tell: All units of these red baby long johns with snap fasteners and a personalized embroidery across the button-up back flap are recalled.

title: Gemmy Industries Corp. Recalls Flashing Eyeball Toys Due to Chemical Hazard
hazard: The plastic eyeball contains kerosene, which, if broken, presents a chemical hazard to children.
remedy: Consumers should take this toy away from children immediately, and return the item to the store for a full refund.
tell: Consumers can identify the recalled toy by checking the model numbers 27828, 27544, or 06470 found on the back of the packaging.

title: First Birthday Party Hats Recalled by Creative Expressions Due to Choking Hazard
hazard: Foil fringe glued to the bottom edge of the party hats can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children.
remedy: Consumers should discard the hats immediately and contact Creative Expressions to receive a full refund.
tell: All blue paper party hats measuring 6.5 inches high by 4.5 inches wide with '1st' printed on the front and blue foil fringe glued to the bottom are recalled.
